sourceEvidence.title: Engineering Manager, Hardware Design
sourceEvidence.quote: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, or industrial hardware development. 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

capture.text:
Who You Are

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, or industrial hardware development.
* 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.
* Strong technical background in mechanical design, electromechanical systems, and robotic hardware development.
* Experience designing end-of-arm tooling, grippers, fixtures, or sensor-integrated robotic systems.
* Understanding of sensor integration, calibration, mechanical tolerances, and hardware reliability.
* Experience developing mechanical and electrical interfaces for complex robotic systems.
* Proficiency in SolidWorks or equivalent CAD software and PDM-based design workflows.
* Demonstrated success bringing complex hardware products from concept through production and deployment.
* Strong technical judgment, project management skills, and ability to balance competing engineering priorities.
* Passionate about developing engineers, solving complex technical challenges, and building high-performing teams.
